in_arabic.name: فاطمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل فطم الذي يعني الانفصال أو الفصل، وتنسب إلى سيدة النساء فاطمة بنت محمد بن عبد الله، ورمز إلى الفتاة الصالحة والطاهرة، وتعني أيضا الانفصال عن الرذيلة والفساد

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو فطم سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے الگ ہونا، اور یہ نام حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی دختر فاطمہ زہرا سے منسوب ہے، اور یہ نیک اور پاک عورت کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़ातिमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ातिमा एक अरबी नाम है जो फطم से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अलग होना, और यह नाम हजरत मुहम्मद साहब की बेटी फ़ातिमा ज़हरा से जुड़ा हुआ है, और यह सच्ची और पवित्र महिला की प्रतीक है

data.cultural_impact: The name Faatima holds a significant place in Islamic history as it is the name of Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) beloved daughter and wife of Imam Ali, the first Shia Imam. Faatima is known for her piety, virtue, and unwavering faith in Allah. She is the embodiment of love and devotion towards the Prophet and the Muslim community. The name continues to be popular among Muslims due to her status as a role model of Islamic values and conduct.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Faatima holds deep spiritual significance in Islam as it is said that Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) termed her as 'Sabihah Al-Kubra' (the superior one) and 'Umm Al-Banin' (the mother of all believers). Faatima is also believed to have had a profound spiritual connection with Allah and was given the inspiration to perform numerous acts of worship, including lengthy prayer, daily fasting, and giving to charity. Her life serves as an example of devotion and dedication to Allah, inspiring Muslims to strive for spiritual growth and spiritual fulfillment.
